text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon once said: To an Umamusume, 
racing is—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"—Survival of the fittest! It's all about 
survival!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To live, and to survive. If you don't 
survive, you'll never become the fastest 
or the strongest.
And those fangs—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Members of the media, lend me your ears! 
I, Agnes Tachyon, will not be running in 
the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Future plans remain undecided as well. Her 
racing activities will be put on 
"indefinite hiatus."

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Eeehhhhh...t?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: What is the meaning of this?!

Watching the press conference on TV, 
Jungle Pocket let out a harsh breath of 
pure anger.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Not running in the Derby...?! Not entering 
the race, you say...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Like hell that's gonna happen!! What the 
hell are we supposed to do without you?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-san, whatever could the reason 
be...? You were considered one of the 
heavy favorites for the upcoming Japanese 
Derby and Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the press conference. 
Talking won't solve anything. —Goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tachyon-san...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, didn't Fuji-san show up on screen 
for a second just now?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't get it. I don't get any of 
this. Tachyon... Fuji-san... Why...?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
How the hell am I supposed to just swallow 
this and keep quiet...?!
(SLAM!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(Tachyon... that bastard... Depending on 
your reason, I'm gonna deck ya!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(What am I supposed to do without you, 
dammit! Who am I supposed to...!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Tachyon—!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you took your time, didn't you? 
Welcome to my laboratory."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I have everything prepared just for you. 
Including iced tea to cool down that 
overheated brain of yours.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Then... your legs...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. My fever just won't go down. I'll 
do everything I can, but if it doesn't 
work out —I just have to accept it.”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I told you it's a battle for survival, 
didn't I? Tomorrow it could be me. 
Naturally, I'm fully prepared for that."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The force applied to the ground equals the 
force pushed back on you. Running fast 
means bearing an equal amount of strain.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There is no way to escape. Not unless you 
give up on running fast.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Though... Fuji-kun did recommend 
something quite similar to that."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
ââ!! Fuji-san! That's right, Fuji-san 
was at the press conference too!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"And earlier, you were talking with Fuji, 
weren't you? What in the world were 
you..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"She suggested that I change my running 
style."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You must have found some fateful 
commonality in my running—or rather, in 
our running. However...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There was no path of obedience. If there 
had been, I would have taken it long ago.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The apple merely fell as it was destined 
to.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So Fuji-san noticed the danger in your 
running and tried somehow to stop you...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmph, that goes without saying.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, Pokke-kun. Thus, I shall 
scrap Plan A. However—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to worry yourself. I have 
a Plan B. So, you should...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Walk your own path—neither A nor B. Just 
like you always have. And then—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"If all my plans fail, you take the lead. 
With your wild instincts! Your sense of 
smell!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"That is—what life is. Now then, do your 
best in the Nippon Derby."

Together with Fuji Kiseki, who had come by 
to visit, I welcomed Jungle Pocket upon 
his return.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see... So you heard what Tachyon and I 
were talking about.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yes... A coincidence... Then Fuji-san 
is...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's not like I was giving advice 
just to win. I was just...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to save her. She was about 
to suffer the same fate I did.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon, I'm worried about you. Your 
legs... share a weakness similar to mine.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ho, what is the scientific basis for that?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—No. It's more like intuition. My heart 
just feels restless. And you are...”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
They're attempting the Classic Triple 
Crown with almost the exact same rotation 
as mine. If this keeps up, could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to worry. No, worrying 
would accomplish nothing anyway. I have my 
own experiments to conduct. Besides...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I am not someone entrusted with your 
dreams. Am I?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the Umamusume who will carry on my 
dream— is Pokke.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Pokke stepped forward herself. So I gladly 
passed on all of my knowledge, experience, 
and passion to her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Pokke will surely achieve it. The Classic 
Triple Crown, especially—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Derby that everyone dreams of. 
On that stage where I never stood, she 
will surely achieve great things.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Fufun, then whatever happens to me—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
However... dreams and prayers are two 
different things.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A prayer...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. Who would ever want that? To have 
my lovely juniors step down... right 
before their dream stage?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want Pokke to do her best. Just as much 
as I want—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I don't want any of you to lose your 
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: This is a prayer. And not just mine alone.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of all those Umamusume who 
couldn't stand on the Derby stage due to 
regrettable injuries.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
To have that kind of conversation with 
Tachyon...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I really wanted to talk about this 
with you. Even if I'm your rival.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I caused a misunderstanding because of 
that, didn't I? And I ended up hurting 
you. I'm so, so sorry. But...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As I said before, the person I entrust my 
one and only wish to will never change.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The successor to my feelings is none other 
than you, Pokke.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: F-Fuji-san...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I'm really sorry... I had no idea...

"The commotion finally died down, leaving 
just me and Jungle Pocket alone. And 
then—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I'm so pathetic... I couldn't 
put full faith in Fuji-san.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Looking up to them on my own, aiming for 
them on my own, and feeling betrayed all 
on my own...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Besides... Tachyon... I never thought she 
would actually disappear...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Not just Tsuzuki, but even the one I was 
aiming to beat... Both friends and rivals 
are disappearing...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So this is... what the Twinkle Series is 
all about, huh.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted a fair and square showdown! 
Where the undisputed strongest takes all 
the glory!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Yet it didn't turn out that way. What am 
I supposed to do...?"

The grandest festival, the Nippon Derby. 
Yet neither her best friend nor her 
strongest rival is there. That is 
precisely why—
choice_data_list:
Let's run our hearts out to make up for 
it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: All out... For Tachyon and Tsuzuki too?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, that's where everyone wanted to 
stand.

Yeah, that's a place where everyone wanted 
to stand.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Tachyon, Tsuduki, Fuji-san too...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"The place everyone whose journey was cut 
short had wanted to reach..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
This doesn't make me feel any better. 
Still! Even so!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta run, don't I?! As the one who 
survived—!!
And the next day—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAAAAGH!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone... Run with me! Run! Please 
run!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(Don't go vanishing on your own! Don't 
leave me alone! Duke it out with me――with 
our running!!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: DAMMIT!! GRAAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eeeek...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: You're too strong, I can't keep up...

Her anger turned directly into power. 
Though she had bounced back, she was now 
so ferocious that no one could act as her 
training partner.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Anyone―― Isn't there anyone out there who 
can give me a real challenge?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"There must be! We're the ones who 
survived. You can burn that life of yours 
even hotter, can't you?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Someone, race with me!
I'm right here with you, Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: You—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Dantsu.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm here. I'm running in the Nihon Derby 
that I've always dreamed of. I can do it. 
And then...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I get to compete on that stage against 
Pokke-chan, my dear friend and the one 
I've always aimed to beat!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
There's no such thing as nobody! I'm right 
here! The one who's gonna be stronger than 
anyone!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"So let's run, Pokke-chan. I want to run 
too, for my own sake."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Dants... Trainer...?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, you're the best partner I could ever 
ask for!

text_block_list.name: Pocket & Dantsu
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOH! YAAAAAAAH!

One end is another beginning. If someone 
stops, someone else will emerge to surpass 
them and shine.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"That's it, bring it on, Dants! More... 
give me more!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Our battle isn't over yet!!
